content: परा {%ind.%} A prefix to verbs and nouns in the sense of ‘away, back, in an inverted order, aside, towards’. According to <ls>G. M.</ls> the senses of परा are:-- .²1 killing, injuring & (पराहत). .²2 going (परागत). .²3 seeing, encountering (परादृष्ट). .²4 prowess (पराक्रान्त). .²5 direction towards (परावृत्त). .²6 excess (पराजित). .²7 dependence (पराधीन). .²8 liberation (पराकृत). .²9 inverted order, backwards (पराङ्मुख). .²10 setting aside, disregarding.
